topics.title: Private sector, public sector and the mixed economy

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the Indian economy is called a mixed economy and identify the forms of private sector organisation.
Describe the public sector and the features of public ownership, public funds and public accountability.
Trace how the Industrial Policy Resolutions of 1948 and 1956 and the 1991 policy defined the roles of the two sectors.
State the features of departmental undertakings as the oldest form of public enterprise.
Evaluate the merits and limitations of departmental undertakings.
Explain the features of statutory corporations created by a Special Act of Parliament.
Evaluate the merits and limitations of statutory corporations.
Define a government company under Section 2(45) of the Companies Act, 2013.
Explain the features, merits and limitations of government companies.

topics.title: Changing role of the public sector

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the role of the public sector in infrastructure, regional balance, economies of scale, checking concentration of economic power and import substitution.
Describe the 1991 reforms: fewer reserved industries, disinvestment, policy on sick units and the MoU system.
Identify the features of global enterprises such as huge capital resources, advanced technology, product innovation and marketing strategies.
Explain centralised control, expansion of market territory and foreign collaboration by global enterprises.

topics.title: Joint ventures and public private partnership

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish between contractual and equity-based joint ventures.
Explain the benefits of joint ventures.
Describe the public private partnership model, its features, strengths and weaknesses.
